name: Dusklow
descriptionSeed: Dusklow — the lit edge of the dark: guides, discreet trades, and people who keep confidences professionally. You hire a guide here to go down, and you come back here to be told what you saw. Nobody in Dusklow repeats anything.
encounterFlavor: traders, apprentices and people from three domains who have learned to share a street

substrateSource.reason: Umbral-worked and deliberately kept low — a settlement that decided long ago it preferred the quiet, and thins what pools there on purpose.
substrateSource.radiusNote: `radius` is in legacy map units; `radiusWorld` is RADII on the sphere and is the one mechanics should use. Chosen by sweep against the authored worldPos: at this scale all 26 sources resolve on the correct side of their region baseline and calibration drift stays ~0.05. Larger radii blanket a whole region (a source at ~55% strength everywhere inside it) and renormalization cancels the field flat — the failure CCode measured and reverted.

axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180). ⚠️ Every component is |0.45| or less by construction: a foothill is not extreme on any axis, which is what distinguishes it from its pole capital.
worldPosNote: ⛔ SNG-407: moved 4.38° (7 walking days) onto the nearest coast the built terrain actually has. Erik: 'keep the land as ground truth now and move the locations slightly to fit the land.' Was colatitude 42, longitude 360.
